name: [2026.1] Nose Down Depth Companion
description: Requires Nose Down by Kugler (Workshop 3729673507); load after it. Hull-specific ordinary-dive depth control by Landomatic, with optional Community Patch settings and reset. Adds opt-in VII torque-cap assistance, deeper PD holds on IIA/IID/IXA and local PD wave-force reduction. New physics options default off. Alarm/crash dives, emergency blows, ballast tanks and valve timing remain outside their scope.
author: Landomatic
